title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J. D. Salinger
summary: After being expelled from his prep school, sixteen-year-old Holden Caulfield wanders New York for a few days, telling the story in a restless, sarcastic voice that hides how lost and lonely he feels.
readIf: you want a sharp, voice-driven portrait of teenage alienation and don't need much plot.
skipIf: you tire quickly of a complaining narrator or a story with no clear destination.

pairings.reason: A more modern, warmer version of an awkward, observant teen narrator finding connection.
Another classic first-person account of a young person struggling in a world that feels fake.
A teen narrator, a boarding school and a search for meaning that ends in grief.
